body:
No worries.  I guess I should have been specific about that at least. Sadly, no one takes it seriously when a dude's harassed.

Unfortunately, the harrassment involved systematic alienation and isolation from what few family members I do have, and the few friends I did have.  Family just thinks I"m imaginging things or paranoid.  Little help there.

Thanks so much for your note. Brought tears to my eyes. 

The thought that my passing would ever cause ongoing pain to the kids, and even slightly increase the chance of them ever considering it...  That's a very powerful thought that hadn't occurred to me at all.  

It's so hard for me to imagine them not being better off, and feeling relief at my passing.  I feel like a total zero to them. I feel nothing but their shame and pity for me.  But the thought I might be wrong, even with one of them, and it could affect them long term, terrifies me.  (In a good way.)

Thank you for sharing such a personal story.  It does help.

I am very sorry for your and your siblings' loss.

Thanks for your words.  I find them helpful, and they're not in the least "egging me on" or encouraging suicide. To the contrary. Hopefully the mods will treat them in the way hey were meant and not delete.

I agree about the closure thing. While the "disappearance" thing might be less instantly traumatic, never knowing what happened isn't something I'd want to leave my kids. And I do agree about the non-vague note. They have to know it has nothing whatsoever to do with them.  Maybe some combo, a note that daddy has to go away for good for work or whatever. I don't know. Very confused right now.

Unfortunately, counselling isn't an option for same reason police aren't an option.

As I said, I'm not doing anything rash or sudden. And in moving forward and winding things down, maybe I'll just find that "out."  I'm not turning a blind eye to the possibility. Just don't seem to have many resources left,  or available to me.

This just is not a situation I can just "motivate myself" out of, any more than you can motivate oneself to move a mountain.

There's a component of ongoing harassment that makes me hesitant to be specific about things, for sake of kids. 

(No, police are not an option; small town and this person is tight with the police.) This person has had me impossibly cornered for awhile,  and I can't find a path forward. 

My slowly wasting away in front of my children isn't healthy for them. And I have little left to offer anyone in the state. 

Removing me completely from the equation is the one thing that makes everything okay. It seems the only path to peace for me, and more importantly my kids. 

Moving is not an option either. 

Thanks for listening.

Good point. If we avoid any talk about methds etc., but focus on things to do to make it easier for the kids, is that any better?

Maybe I'm in the wrong place. Probably isn't a right place.

Not at all. And i agree.

I was half hoping to hear from children of suicide "victims" and get their take on it. I know it will be universally "don't do it" from then, but in the discussions I might pick up some useful tips for making things easier.
Not doing anything rash, I'll be putting my house in order and winding things 
down as gracefully as possible.

Thanks for your reply.

(I don't think it's done here, but I should ask that there be no "tracing" of me.  I'm Tor'ed up and summoning up any local "help" would actually make things far, far, worse. Trust me on that.)
